description: Extension of the OnboardingView providing various user interaction methods related to gateway selection, navigation, settings, and UI feedback within the onboarding flow.

methods.name: selectLocalGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local, clears the preferred gateway ID, hides advanced connection, and updates preferences.

methods.name: selectUnconfiguredGateway
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing onboarding wizard, sets connection mode to unconfigured, and resets related preferences.

methods.name: selectRemoteGateway
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing onboarding wizard, sets preferred gateway ID, updates preferences, applies remote selection, and updates the connection mode.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Requests opening a specific settings tab and posts a notification to update the UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Navigates back in the onboarding pages with animation.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next onboarding page or finishes if at the end, with validation for blocking states.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks onboarding as seen, records the version, and closes the onboarding controller.

methods.name: copyToPasteboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to the system clipboard and temporarily shows a copied indicator.
